title: Prajna Paramita 1 Three Marks
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett's main teaching from the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of transcending limited thinking and dualism in order to achieve a deeper understanding of reality. By studying the three marks of reality - impermanence, dissatisfaction, and no-self - we can become more accepting and comfortable with the interconnectedness of experience, leading to a wisdom that supports practices like selflessness and acceptance of change. This approach encourages us to look beyond surface-level explanations and explore the underlying complexities of our thoughts and emotions, ultimately cultivating true wisdom and self-awareness.
topics: asatka (no-self or lack of constant existence)
